user_temp.name: User temporary files
user_temp.description: Temporary files in %TEMP%. Some may be locked while apps run.

prefetch.name: Prefetch cache
prefetch.description: Windows recreates it; frees space with no lasting performance impact.

crashdumps.name: Crash dumps
crashdumps.description: Error dumps in the CrashDumps folder.

gpu_cache.name: GPU shader caches
gpu_cache.description: NVIDIA DXCache and AMD DxCache folders.

windows_update_cache.name: Windows Update download cache
windows_update_cache.description: Contents of SoftwareDistribution\Download. Services are stopped temporarily.
windows_update_cache.warning: Downloaded but not yet installed updates are deleted; they will be downloaded again.

delivery_optimization.name: Delivery Optimization cache
delivery_optimization.description: Update fragments shared with other computers.

old_logs.name: Old setup and update logs
old_logs.description: CBS, DISM and Windows Update log files.

recycle_bin.name: Recycle Bin
recycle_bin.warning: Files in the Recycle Bin cannot be recovered.

windows_old.name: Windows.old (previous version)
windows_old.description: Previous Windows installation left after an upgrade. No rollback remains.
windows_old.warning: You can no longer roll back to the previous Windows version. Usually frees 10-30 GB.

dism_cleanup.name: WinSxS component cleanup (DISM)
dism_cleanup.description: Removes unused Windows components. May take a long time.
dism_cleanup.warning: This can take 10-40 minutes. Updates can no longer be uninstalled.
